plugin.name: Claude Subscription ACP Agent
plugin.description: Adds a Claude Subscription agent to JetBrains AI chat that authenticates with a Claude.ai Pro/Max subscription.
plugin.change-notes:
0.2.1
Node.js is now found on Windows: node.exe with the flat node_modules\npm layout (official installer, nvm-windows), and IDE runtimes under %LOCALAPPDATA%\JetBrains.

0.2.0
New optional model setting: the starting model for the IDE session, passed to the agent as ANTHROPIC_MODEL, so the IDE can start on a different model than ~/.claude/settings.json gives the CLI. Subagents keep their own model:.
